name: American University of Armenia
summary: English-taught liberal-arts university in Yerevan, with eight four-year degrees open to school leavers.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Business
programmes.about: Business degree covering management, accounting, marketing and economics, with a liberal-arts foundation and professional decision-making skills.
programmes.overview: Students study accounting, management, marketing and economics, alongside broader liberal-arts courses. The curriculum develops quantitative and analytical reasoning, communication and decision-making for business problems. Required and elective courses support different business interests, including marketing and accounting. The programme prepares graduates for roles across commercial organisations, finance and management, for starting enterprises, or for further graduate-level study.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of school results, English and maths evidence, essays and activities; an interview may be requested. Screening scores differ by programme.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Economics
programmes.about: Quantitative economics degree combining economic theory, analytical methods, applied research and evidence-based policy or business decision-making.
programmes.overview: The first two years establish economic principles and quantitative methods before students move into more specialised topics and electives. Students investigate economic questions using analytical reasoning and evidence-based methods. A final-year capstone project or thesis provides an opportunity to integrate their learning in a research task. Graduates can pursue analytical work in public or private organisations, or further study in economics and related fields.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of school results, English and maths evidence, essays and activities; an interview may be requested. Screening scores differ by programme.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in English and Communications
programmes.about: Study of English language and literature alongside contemporary media, communication, writing and critical approaches to culture.
programmes.overview: The programme links English language and literature with contemporary media, cultural and literary theory. Students develop writing, interpretation, communication and critical analysis skills that apply across different audiences and formats. Its curriculum supports interests in communication practice, public relations, and writing or translation. Graduates may seek work in journalism, publishing, media, translation and communications, or continue into related postgraduate study.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of school results, English and maths evidence, essays and activities; an interview may be requested. Screening scores differ by programme.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Politics and Governance
programmes.about: Interdisciplinary exploration of political institutions, citizenship, governance, decision-making and the resolution of public conflicts.
programmes.overview: Students examine how politics, social institutions and governance interact in Armenia and across the world. The curriculum addresses citizenship, democracy, the rule of law, political decision-making and conflict resolution from local to international settings. Students practise evaluating competing positions and building evidence-based arguments about public problems. The degree provides preparation for work in public bodies, nongovernmental organisations, research and consulting, or for further study.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of school results, English and maths evidence, essays and activities; an interview may be requested. Screening scores differ by programme.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
programmes.about: Computer science degree joining mathematics and computing, including algorithms, software development, artificial intelligence and modelling.
programmes.overview: Students build a foundation in mathematical reasoning and computational problem-solving, with work in algorithms, data structures and software engineering. The curriculum also covers areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, cryptography and computer graphics. Electives permit a focus on applied computing, mathematical modelling or a more general pathway. The programme supports progression into software and technology-related employment, or graduate study in computing and associated disciplines.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of school results, English and maths evidence, essays and activities; an interview may be requested. Screening scores differ by programme.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Data Science
programmes.about: Data science degree integrating mathematics, statistics, programming and practical methods for understanding complex datasets.
programmes.overview: The core curriculum combines theoretical mathematics, advanced statistics, computer programming and applied data analysis. Students use techniques such as visualisation, machine learning and artificial intelligence to address problems involving data. Elective study can focus on business analytics or bioinformatics. The programme prepares students to work with data in commercial or scientific settings and to pursue advanced study in computational, engineering or life-science fields.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of school results, English and maths evidence, essays and activities; an interview may be requested. Screening scores differ by programme.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Engineering Sciences
programmes.about: Broad engineering degree combining foundational science, mathematics and multiple engineering disciplines to examine integrated systems.
programmes.overview: Students study engineering as an interdisciplinary field rather than choosing one traditional engineering specialism at entry. The curriculum draws on mathematics, physical science and engineering concepts to investigate complex technical systems. Design, innovation, problem-solving and communication are emphasised, including consideration of practical challenges. The degree offers a basis for analytical and technology-related employment or postgraduate study in engineering, robotics, computer science and related areas.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of school results, English and maths evidence, essays and activities; an interview may be requested. Screening scores differ by programme.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Environmental and Sustainability Sciences
programmes.about: Interdisciplinary environmental science degree examining climate, ecosystems, water, land, cities and pathways to sustainable development.
programmes.overview: The programme examines how human activity affects climate, biodiversity, natural resources and the built environment. Study includes problems such as urban mobility, energy, air quality, water management, waste and circular-economy systems. Students learn scientific inquiry, data analysis, systems thinking and the communication of environmental findings. The programme provides opportunities for practical experience and prepares graduates for sustainability-oriented work or further study across environmental and policy-related fields.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of school results, English and maths evidence, essays and activities; an interview may be requested. Screening scores differ by programme.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma accepted; no IB points minimum located. English proficiency and SAT/ACT maths evidence or an approved waiver are required. Selection is holistic; programme screening thresholds differ.

notes: International students who do not speak Armenian are not required to take Armenian-taught courses.
The Nursing degree is a bridging route for nursing or midwifery diploma holders, so it is excluded from this school-leaver list.
Tuition shown is the Fall 2027 international rate before aid; Armenian-status subsidies can change it, and a services fee and health insurance are extra.
